limitations_and_boundaries: Generalization to unseen patients is only feasible if similar samples have been observed in the unperturbed setting and the training set contains similar perturbation responses. This was confirmed by failure on glioblastoma cohort with small size and high variance.

Predictive performance drops when perturbations are too strong (cell distributions before and after are very different), as the OT principle is best suited for acute perturbations preserving correlation structure.
CellOT models cell responses as deterministic trajectories, not accounting for stochasticity or heteroscedasticity.
Performance drops for sparsely represented cell types (e.g., in hematopoiesis).
Method has been evaluated on relatively small datasets; large-scale validation needed.
